dataset.description:
This dataset is related to the software used and developed in the MaPSI project. The main software for generating scientific results and publications is Porepy1, which is a open source Python simulation framework hosted on GitHub2. Other open source simulation tools may be considered following the research conducted in the project.



1PorePy (open-source code, Porous Media Group, University of Bergen): https://github.com/pmgbergen/porepy 

2GitHub (private company, subsidiary of Microsoft): https://github.com/
dataset.title: MaPSI software

dataset.description:
The project will generate several scientific publications and the run-scripts are dedicated to reproducing the results of each publication. The reference data is the result of numerical experiments in the project as a result of the execution of the MaPSI run-scripts. Run-scripts, generated reference data, and related metadata for each publication are compiled in a single Zenodo repository versioned with a DOI.


This dataset description is related to MaPSI run-scripts and the generated reference data.
dataset.title: MaPSI run-scripts and generated reference data

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) refers to the data sets generated by the MaPSI project as a basis for scientific publication of project results. This includes data generated by numerical experiments and the related software, associated documentation, and metadata.  The project will only undertake research based on input data and software that is publicly available at the start of the relevant research task or can be made publicly available by the time of publication of related research results. 

The data generated by numerical experiments are referred to as MaPSI reference data and the run-scripts for performing the numerical experiments are referred to as MaPSI runscripts. The related developed software, including associated documentation, is referred to as MaPSI software. The plan is based on the guidelines on FAIR Data Management and the principles of FAIR research software1


1Katz, D. S., Gruenpeter, M., & Honeyman, T. (2021). Taking a fresh look at FAIR for research software. Patterns, 2(3), 100222.

project.title: Mathematical and Numerical Modelling of Process-Structure Interaction in Fractured Geothermal Systems (MaPSI)
